name: IC Analog — 5V, SPI — SOIC
description: Cluster of 5V surface-mount analog ICs using an SPI interface in SOIC packages including SOIC-8, SOIC-14, and SOIC-16W footprints.
selection_hints: Select when requiring a 5V analog IC with SPI digital interface.
Choose for surface-mount designs utilizing 1.27mm pitch SOIC footprints (SOIC-8, SOIC-14, or SOIC-16W).
Match specific pin count and function (such as ADC or DAC) to project requirements.
avoid_when: Avoid if the system requires a non-5V operating supply.
Avoid if an interface protocol other than SPI is required.
Avoid if through-hole mounting or package families other than SOIC are needed.
